summary: Backend + Mobile UI verified end-to-end on Expo web preview. Backend pytest suite: 15/15 PASS. Frontend critical flows all working: PIN lock (1234) → tabs, Home dashboard (₹2,020 outstanding, 5 customer rows, red/green balance colors), Customers tab (search + 4 chips), Customer detail (balance & tx history & add-entry), Add Customer (from Home + icon), Voice manual-text parse ('Ramesh 450 udhaar' → navigates to /add-transaction with customer_id of Ramesh Kumar, type=credit, amount=450 prefilled), Settings (edit shop name, re-seed, lock). Risk badges: Anita Devi=red, Priya Sharma=yellow, Suresh Patel=green/cleared as per spec. No JS page errors. Two minor React Native console deprecation warnings detected.

minor.issue: Uses LlmChat model 'gpt-5.4-mini' which may be invalid; fallback to regex parser kicks in. Not in test scope (audio path) but worth verifying model id with provider playbook.

issues: React Native web console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' (multiple occurrences from card/elevation styles)
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — likely from a lib but worth checking custom usage

action_items: (Optional/minor) Replace deprecated `shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius` style props with `boxShadow` on web, or guard with Platform.select to silence warnings on web build.

(Optional/minor) Verify the LLM model id used in /api/voice/parse — 'gpt-5.4-mini' may not exist; consider 'gpt-5.1-mini' or current valid model. Audio flow already falls back to local regex parser so user-facing impact is low.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses MongoDB UUID `id` and excludes `_id` in find projections ✅
All API routes prefixed with /api ✅; CORS allow-all ✅
Risk computation uses FIFO unpaid-credit aging — correctly classifies Anita (35d=red), Priya (18d=yellow), Suresh (paid=green) ✅
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL ✅ (matches Expo public env convention)
seed_data_creation: Used POST /api/seed (5 demo customers) before tests. Tests also created/cleaned ephemeral TEST_ customers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App URL: https://udhaar-track-6.preview.emergentagent.com. PIN: 1234. Shop name: Sharma Kirana Store. Voice tab supports manual text input (testID voice-manual-input/voice-manual-submit) which navigates to /add-transaction with prefilled params (customer_id, initial_type, initial_amount). Audio mic flow requires native build; web preview cannot test it. To force lock screen, clear localStorage 'kut_session_unlocked'. Tab bar items are clickable via locator text= and last-match (not by accessibility role=button). Tab labels: Home, Customers, Voice, Settings.
